details:
At the moment we can't change light probe properties in Udon Graph, insert SH from probes via public variables, or really insert any SH data. When users turn on a light in a world, a physical light can handle direct lighting information and shaders can handle fake lighting on the walls, but we're not able to move probes, tetrahedralize, change coefficients/colors, add lights to probes, etc. leaving GI for players in the dark. Some avatar shaders only use light probe information, which is very limiting.

Having access to the light probe functions in Udon Graph would allow dynamics that are much easier to process and have many optimal use cases:

- Alternate lighting scenarios swapping or editing probes, then cost no more than already-baked light probes (dynamic lighting on Android)

- Speed up dynamic rendering for light toggles

- Moving light probes

- Injecting video light into world GI

- Custom GI dynamics and controls (dynamically colored areas on a game map that impacts player colors and lighting)

There are currently some functions to adjust spherical harmonics in Udon, but without being able to influence light probes I'm not sure how we're expected to use these functions.
title: Access to Light Probes and Spherical Harmonics in Udon Graph
